content_of_post_to_answer: How can I understand my own thoughts, emotions, and habits better?
answer: A useful way to understand yourself is to study patterns rather than individual moments. A thought tells you what crossed your mind; an emotion tells you what mattered; a habit shows what you repeatedly do when the same kind of situation appears. Look for the connection between them. Self-understanding becomes much clearer when you stop asking “Why am I like this?” and start asking “What reliably happens before I become like this?”
